verdict.rationale: Deel publishes a documented public REST API with concrete endpoints (POST https://api.letsdeel.com/rest/contracts), API-token and OAuth2 authentication, header-based date versioning, and an isolated sandbox. Agent-friendly docs (llms.txt, Markdown pages) and an MCP server whose tools map to API operations make it straightforward to drive programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage and breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: # Create a contractor contract POST https://api.letsdeel.com/rest/contracts
Deel supports two authentication methods: ... API tokens ... OAuth2
The Deel API uses **header-based date versioning** as the standard for managing API changes.
The Deel API Sandbox is a **completely isolated testing environment** that mirrors production functionality without affecting real data
The Deel MCP server exposes tools that map to Deel API operations.
